stress_energy.canonical_tensor: T^{mu nu}_can = (d^mu phi)(d^nu phi) - eta^{mu nu} L_scalar
stress_energy.symmetric_tensor: T^{mu nu}_sym = (d^mu phi)(d^nu phi) - 1/2 eta^{mu nu}[(d_alpha phi)(d^alpha phi) - m_eff^2 phi^2 - 2V_int(phi)]
stress_energy.energy_density_component: T^{00} = 1/2[(partial_t phi)^2 + |grad phi|^2 + m_eff^2 phi^2] + V_int(phi)
